_comment: Guided tour of step 1 (Data Selection) of the native Burst Analysis workflow. Targets are item_rects keys of BurstDataSelectionApp; the action steps wait for the control.

steps.title: The raw data of the whole workflow
steps.text: Every later step reads the files listed here: the burst search, the IRF and background, the burst-wise FCS. Add them once.

steps.title: Add the measurements
steps.text: Choose TTTR files (or a folder of them, or drop them on the window). Each new local file is stored in MMFDB and registered as raw data.

await.hint: Press Add files and choose one or more TTTR files.

steps.title: Check what was registered
steps.text: Select a file to see its size, date and MMFDB record. A failed registration says why and can be repeated with Import again.

steps.title: Go on
steps.text: The burst search (step 2) gets these files and the detector setup of step 0.
